scope: Fifteen numbered additions include a sharp fixed-memory singularity and two supporting lemmas; the finite-n search saddle, projected support rigidity, exact saturation criterion, explicit prior and memory bounds, effective rational cap and elementary fallback; and the full two-location refinement. Classical restatements, supporting lemmas and corollaries are identified separately. This is not a count of fifteen new discoveries.

statements.proof: Partition log-failure increments into rational commensurability classes. Distinct classes share only finitely many tied items, leaving a deterministic class suffix of every greedy word. Class frequency ratios are irrational between distinct classes, contradicting projected-output periodicity for any finite stochastic controller. When all increments share one lattice, bounded relative logarithmic states give finite deterministic orbits. A counted pure initial label implements the optimal finite word mixture after its first sampled command.

statements.conclusion: Finite saturation is decidable by positive rational collinearity of signed prime exponent vectors.
